ndce111c653.headline: Trump, trade worries cloud COP29 climate summit
ndce111c653.summary: Nations are preparing for tough talks on finance and trade as the annual UN climate summit kicked off. Trump's policy stance has added to trade worries overshadowing the talks.
ndce111c653.why: COP climate summits set frameworks for climate finance and carbon policy, which affect energy investment, carbon pricing and emissions-linked trade rules.

ne413c66d8d.headline: Chalmers Warns Trump's Tariffs Could Impact Global Trade, Australia To Face 'Relatively Mild' Effects
ne413c66d8d.summary: Treasurer Jim Chalmers said the direct impact of Trump's tariffs on Australia would be relatively mild. He warned the broader effect on major trading partners and the global trading system could be more significant.
ne413c66d8d.why: Tariffs change trade flows between major economies, affecting exporters, shipping and global growth expectations.

nabe8bbc5e8.headline: How Trump's second White House term could impact the economy
nabe8bbc5e8.summary: President-elect Trump's economic agenda for his second White House term will include some old and new policies compared with his first administration. The article does not specify the measures in the summary.
nabe8bbc5e8.why: Presidential economic policy shapes tax, trade and regulatory expectations that drive US equity and bond markets.

n6033982e85.headline: Vodacom reflects on 30 years, looks ahead to growth
n6033982e85.summary: Vodacom said geographic diversification is driving higher service revenue and EBITDA. The company now connects 206 million customers and serves 83 million with financial services.
n6033982e85.why: Vodacom is a South African mobile operator with African operations, and its results reflect demand for telecom and mobile financial services across the continent.

impacts.name: Vodacom
impacts.why: Rising service revenue and EBITDA from geographic diversification point to stronger operating performance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nf004852a9a.headline: Singapore and China sign 25 agreements at annual top-level bilateral meeting to boost cooperation
nf004852a9a.summary: Singapore and China signed 25 agreements at the 20th Joint Council for Bilateral Cooperation meeting. Singapore DPM Gan Kim Yong and Chinese Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang co-chaired the talks.
nf004852a9a.why: Bilateral agreements between two major Asian economies can shape trade, investment and cooperation in areas such as finance and infrastructure.

nf6d98b62df.headline: Finance Minister: Performance of Hungary's business sector has been 'impressive'
nf6d98b62df.summary: Hungary's finance minister said the government's Eastern Opening policy has brought record foreign direct investment to the country. He described the performance of the business sector as impressive.
nf6d98b62df.why: Foreign direct investment levels indicate investor confidence in a country's economy and its industrial base.

nbc0db35af0.headline: Ammonnews : CBJ issues second treasury bonds worth $110 million
nbc0db35af0.summary: On behalf of the government, the Central Bank of Jordan announced the issuance of a second treasury bond tranche worth $110 million.
nbc0db35af0.why: Treasury bonds are the government's main domestic borrowing instrument, and issuance sizes affect public debt financing and local yields.

nab95eae107.headline: Donald Trump, trade worries cloud COP29 climate summit in Baku
nab95eae107.summary: The UN climate summit opened in Baku with countries preparing for tough talks on finance and trade. Developing countries are pressing for climate funding after a year of weather disasters.
nab95eae107.why: Climate finance commitments shape investment flows into energy transition projects and affect trade and policy planning across sectors.

na65e35b5af.headline: Stock market update: Nifty IT index  1.28%
na65e35b5af.summary: The Nifty IT index closed down 1.28% at 42,590.30 on the National Stock Exchange of India, based on the input report.
na65e35b5af.why: The Nifty IT index tracks major Indian information technology companies, which earn much of their revenue from overseas clients.

nbcce911af2.headline: Budget meeting scrapped as German parties wrangle over election timing
nbcce911af2.summary: German legislators scrapped a budget planning meeting on Monday as parties continued to argue over the timing of an election to end political uncertainty.
nbcce911af2.why: Germany's budget and election timing shape fiscal policy and investor views on Europe's largest economy.

ne06e4907ea.headline: TSX futures rise ahead of data-heavy week
ne06e4907ea.summary: Futures tied to Canada's main stock index rose on Monday, mirroring Wall Street, as investors focused on key economic indicators including US inflation data this week.
ne06e4907ea.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark, heavily weighted toward financials and energy.

nf17f6e57c7.headline: COP29: US climate envoy says work will continue despite Trump's return
nf17f6e57c7.summary: At COP29 in Baku, US climate envoy John Podesta urged governments to keep faith in the US climate promise. He said Donald Trump can slow, but not stop, the energy transition.
nf17f6e57c7.why: The COP climate summits set international frameworks for emissions and energy transition policy. US policy direction affects energy investment and climate-related regulation globally.

nc60396bd6a.headline: Government plans early bond market re-entry
nc60396bd6a.summary: Ghana, shut out of the international capital market, plans to re-enter the domestic bond market earlier than the typical recovery timeline after completing its debt exchange in September 2023.
nc60396bd6a.why: Ghana's government bonds are a key funding source, and renewed access to foreign investors signals improving sovereign debt market conditions.

n5fe2de058c.headline: Electric car market on the verge of an upswing
n5fe2de058c.summary: Hungarian Economics Minister Márton Nagy said the European market for electric cars is on the verge of an upswing.
n5fe2de058c.why: The European electric vehicle market shapes demand for battery makers and automakers across the region, including Hungary's growing auto manufacturing sector.

nc0f948c542.headline: Students hopeful as Greens try to outbid Labor on debt
nc0f948c542.summary: Australia's Greens have called for all student debt to be wiped under a plan costing $74 billion. The proposal is being framed as an attempt to outbid Labor on the issue.
nc0f948c542.why: Government student debt policy affects public finances and the budget outlook. Large fiscal commitments can influence bond markets and government spending.

nb7ef56b156.headline: Delta govt approves N936bn proposed 2025 budget
nb7ef56b156.summary: The Delta state government has approved a proposed N936 billion budget for the 2025 fiscal year. The budget now moves forward as the state plans spending for the year.
nb7ef56b156.why: State budgets set public spending in Nigerian states and affect local infrastructure, contracts and economic activity.

n534cba02ab.headline: MARKET REPORT: Gold miner loses third of value after arrests
n534cba02ab.summary: Shares of a gold miner lost a third of their value after three executives were arrested. They had been in Mali for talks with local mining and tax authorities.
n534cba02ab.why: Gold miners' earnings depend on operating permits, taxes and government relations in producing countries, so arrests of executives can quickly reprice their equity.
n534cba02ab.why_moved: Shares fell by about a third after three executives were arrested while in Mali for talks with local mining and tax authorities.

nb75de59964.headline: Indian bond yields edge higher ahead of local, US inflation data
nb75de59964.summary: Indian government bond yields ended slightly higher after a range-bound session on Monday, as investors awaited domestic and US inflation data.
nb75de59964.why: Government bond yields in India reflect expectations for inflation and the central bank's policy path, and they are closely watched by banks and fixed-income investors.

nd85abaec93.headline: PNM announces plan to join CAISO EDAM regional energy market
nd85abaec93.summary: Public Service Company of New Mexico, a wholly owned subsidiary of PNM Resources, announced plans to join the CAISO EDAM regional energy market.
nd85abaec93.why: Regional energy markets allow utilities to trade electricity across wider areas, which can lower costs and improve grid reliability for customers.

n11d4a1a44c.headline: NNPCL to deliver 12 CNG mother stations, LNG mini plants — Kyari
n11d4a1a44c.summary: NNPC Ltd Group Chief Executive Mele Kyari said the company has perfected plans to deliver 12 CNG mother stations and LNG mini plants.
n11d4a1a44c.why: NNPC Ltd is Nigeria's state-owned oil and gas company, and its gas infrastructure plans affect domestic gas supply and the country's shift toward cleaner fuels.

n53fd3bbc89.headline: Trump transition boss Howard Lutnick, CEO of Cantor Fitzgerald,  in running for Treasury secretary: report
n53fd3bbc89.summary: Howard Lutnick, CEO of Cantor Fitzgerald and head of Trump's transition team, is reportedly in running for Treasury secretary.
n53fd3bbc89.why: The US Treasury secretary oversees federal fiscal policy, debt issuance and key financial-sector regulation.

n1a7b765fda.headline: Legal battle over? - Expert to be roped in to resolve Eskom and City Power's billing dispute
n1a7b765fda.summary: An expert is to be brought in to resolve the billing dispute between Eskom and City Power, over a disputed bill of R3.4 billion according to City Power.
n1a7b765fda.why: Eskom is South Africa's state electricity utility, and municipal debt disputes with it affect public finances and power supply.

ne475ed758b.headline: Sensex, Nifty close flat amid unabated foreign fund outflows, muted earnings
ne475ed758b.summary: Benchmark Sensex gained 9.83 points to close at 79,496.15, as indexes ended flat amid unabated foreign fund outflows and muted earnings.
ne475ed758b.why: The Sensex is the benchmark index of the Bombay Stock Exchange, and foreign institutional flows are a major driver of Indian equity prices.

n67c4219d10.headline: Akufo-Addo unveils third biggest gold mine; solidifies Ghana’s position as Africa’s leading gold producer
n67c4219d10.summary: President Akufo-Addo inaugurated the Cardinal Namdini gold mine in the Upper East Region, marking the first gold pour. The project is described as the third-biggest gold mine in Ghana.
n67c4219d10.why: Gold mining output shapes Ghana's export revenue and government income, and Ghana is among Africa's leading gold producers.

n204ea98dcb.headline: London’s Aquis stock market agrees £194m takeover by Swiss group
n204ea98dcb.summary: Aquis Stock Exchange, which serves smaller and fast-growing businesses, agreed a £194m takeover by a Swiss group. The acquisition is intended to help it expand in Europe.
n204ea98dcb.why: Aquis is a UK-based equities exchange for smaller companies, and changes in its ownership affect how these firms access capital markets.

na02f9813ae.headline: Cedi sinks to GH¢17.30 against the dollar at some forex bureaus
na02f9813ae.summary: The Ghanaian cedi continues to depreciate against the US dollar, selling at GH¢17.30 at some forex bureaus as of November 11, 2024. Checks by GhanaWeb Business found the rate at 10:00 AM.
na02f9813ae.why: The cedi's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and foreign-currency debt for Ghana, which investors track for sovereign and local-market risk.

n09ccab6734.headline: Ammonnews : Oil little changed as US storm threat abates
n09ccab6734.summary: Oil prices were little changed on Monday as the threat of supply disruptions from a US storm eased. The report gave no further price figures.
n09ccab6734.why: Brent crude is the main global oil benchmark, and oil prices feed into fuel costs, inflation expectations and energy-company earnings.

n774456447e.headline: Remittances growth to strengthen account balance amid low growth
n774456447e.summary: Remittances to Pakistan hit a record high in October, according to the All Pakistan Business Forum. The forum said the inflows are crucial for the account balance amid low FDI and weak export growth.
n774456447e.why: Remittances are a key source of foreign-currency inflows for Pakistan, and they affect its current account, reserves and exchange rate.

n2b6136845b.headline: Boosting Non-oil Revenue With 2024 Tax Bill
n2b6136845b.summary: According to the Central Bank of Nigeria's second-quarter economic report, the country's inability to meet its revenue target pushed the budget deficit higher. The report links the shortfall to the 2024 tax bill.
n2b6136845b.why: Revenue shortfalls widen fiscal deficits, which affect government borrowing needs and Nigerian sovereign and naira-denominated assets.

n2d2a7d4bd8.headline: Can Rs 500 crore govt scheme make India self reliant in medical devices manufacturing? - BusinessToday
n2d2a7d4bd8.summary: Experts say a Rs 500 crore government scheme could stimulate local medical device production, drive innovation and improve India's competitiveness in the global MedTech market.
n2d2a7d4bd8.why: Medical devices are a growing manufacturing segment, and government incentives affect local producers' competitiveness against imports.

n3cd0905fff.headline: Fuel price crisis: Why Dangote is against exploiting Nigerians
n3cd0905fff.summary: Dangote Refinery disclosed that it sells petrol at N990 per litre into trucks. The disclosure comes amid a fuel price crisis in Nigeria.
n3cd0905fff.why: Dangote Refinery is a large privately owned refinery in Lagos, and its pump and ex-refinery pricing shapes Nigeria's fuel market.

source.name: The Guardian Nigeria News - Nigeria and World News

sources.name: The Guardian Nigeria News - Nigeria and World News

nd52c65c92f.headline: Bank of England economist warns of 'disturbances' that could hit interest rates
nd52c65c92f.summary: A Bank of England economist warned of 'disturbances' that could hit interest rates. The warning came after the Bank cut its rate from 5% to 4.75%.
nd52c65c92f.why: The Bank of England sets the UK's benchmark interest rate, which influences borrowing costs, sterling and gilt yields across the British economy.

n54f874dc11.headline: Government Provides $80 Million Lifeline to Struggling Regional Airline Rex
n54f874dc11.summary: The Australian government is providing an $80 million lifeline to Rex Airlines. Rex will continue to fly multiple remote and regional routes.
n54f874dc11.why: Rex is a regional Australian airline, and government support keeps remote air connectivity and related jobs in place while the carrier faces financial strain.

n9017955aa7.headline: ‘Living minimum wage’
n9017955aa7.summary: A number of Nigerian states are set to implement the new N70,000 national minimum wage law. Indications suggest workers across the country are still struggling with living costs.
n9017955aa7.why: Minimum wage levels affect labour costs for employers and household incomes, and they are an important element of inflation and consumer demand in Nigeria.

ne0ec6287dd.headline: Edtech startup Bhanzu raises USD 16.5 mn  in funding led by Epiq Capital, Z3Partners, others
ne0ec6287dd.summary: Math learning platform Bhanzu raised $16.5 million in a funding round led by Epiq Capital and Z3Partners. Existing investors Lightspeed Ventures and Eight Roads also participated.
ne0ec6287dd.why: Venture funding rounds indicate investor appetite for education technology startups in India's growing startup market.

nfc4211293b.headline: RWE commences construction of operation and maintenance base for Thor offshore wind farm
nfc4211293b.summary: A ground-breaking ceremony at the Port of Thorsminde marked the official start of construction of a service base for RWE's Thor offshore wind farm.
nfc4211293b.why: RWE is a German utility and a major offshore wind developer, and such bases support long-term operation of wind farms.

n24a5e455a5.headline: Students hopeful as Greens try to outbid Labor on debt
n24a5e455a5.summary: The Greens have called for all student debt to be wiped under a plan they put at $74 billion. The proposal is presented as an alternative to Labor's approach on student debt.
n24a5e455a5.why: Government debt and spending commitments of this size affect Australia's fiscal outlook and the bond market that funds it.

n9454023405.headline: Japan PM Ishiba survives parliament vote as Trump casts shadow
n9454023405.summary: Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba will lead a fragile minority government. Tasks ahead include a supplementary budget, the G20 summit and the risk of potential US trade measures.
n9454023405.why: Japan is a major economy and the US is its key trade partner, so policy and trade decisions affect yen assets and Japanese exporters.

n2248d555a6.headline: Atiku accuses Tinubu’s policies of 'killing Nigerians' amid rising inflation
n2248d555a6.summary: Former vice president Atiku Abubakar has criticised President Bola Tinubu's economic policies, claiming they are worsening hardships for Nigerians amid rising inflation.
n2248d555a6.why: Nigeria's economic policy and inflation trajectory influence the naira, central bank decisions and foreign investor sentiment toward Africa's largest economy.

n0c5a8f84af.headline: USD/CAD Outlook: Downbeat Data Weakens Canadian Dollar
n0c5a8f84af.summary: The Canadian dollar remains weak after downbeat data, and the USD/CAD outlook suggests the move could extend on Friday.
n0c5a8f84af.why: The Canadian dollar reflects Canada's economy and its close trade ties with the US, and it affects commodity exporters and cross-border investment.

ne6a352cb59.headline: Soft loans for SMEs must to achieve high economic growth target: BMP
ne6a352cb59.summary: The Businessmen Panel of the Federation of Pakistan Chambers of Commerce and Industry asked the government for soft financing at very low interest rates and without collateral for SMEs. The aim is to spur economic growth.
ne6a352cb59.why: Small and medium enterprises make up a large share of employment in Pakistan, and credit access affects their growth.

n887f853fdd.headline: Nissan announces drastic job cuts and reduction in sales figures
n887f853fdd.summary: Nissan announced drastic job cuts and a reduction in sales figures. Slowing sales in North America were cited as one reason for the workforce reduction.
n887f853fdd.why: Nissan Motor is a Japanese automaker with major operations in North America, so its volume and cost decisions affect global auto supply and peers. Restructuring typically follows weaker demand.

nc5f4045103.headline: UBS trials blockchain-based payment system
nc5f4045103.summary: Swiss bank UBS said it successfully piloted UBS Digital Cash, a blockchain-based payment system designed to improve cross-border transaction efficiency. The pilot involved multinational clients and banks, including domestic transactions in Switzerland.
nc5f4045103.why: UBS is one of the largest global wealth managers and investment banks, and its payment innovations can affect cross-border banking costs.

n7bc1135640.headline: Hedge Funds Were Most Bearish on Yen Since August Before US Vote
n7bc1135640.summary: Hedge funds turned the most negative on the yen since August in the run-up to last week's US presidential election, suggesting positioning for a Trump victory.
n7bc1135640.why: Speculative positioning in the yen affects currency volatility, and the yen is a key funding currency for global carry trades.

n1fd397fbbf.headline: Fine Gael pledges to spend 10bn euro of Apple money on housing
n1fd397fbbf.summary: Fine Gael has pledged to spend 10 billion euro of money received from Apple on housing if it is elected.
n1fd397fbbf.why: Apple's tax payments to Ireland, which were subject to a European Commission ruling, are a major fiscal item for the Irish state and its housing budget.

n116944d3d3.headline: Rich Ricci to scoop £16m in sale of LSE rival Aquis Exchange
n116944d3d3.summary: Aquis Exchange has backed a £207m takeover offer from Zurich-based SIX, and former Barclays banker Rich Ricci, a major shareholder, stands to receive £16m.
n116944d3d3.why: Aquis is a UK-based stock exchange, and SIX is the Swiss operator of exchanges, so the deal signals consolidation in European trading venues.

n2650fe7f9f.headline: THAI reports Q3 financial performance
n2650fe7f9f.summary: Thai Airways International reported Q3 2024 revenue of THB45,828 million, up 23.8% from a year earlier. It carried 3.94 million passengers, with average cabin factor at 76.1%, down from 77.3%.
n2650fe7f9f.why: Thai Airways is Thailand's national carrier, and its results reflect demand, load factors and fuel and cost pressures in Asian aviation.

n93679e4c35.headline: Senate OKs bill on natural gas dev’t in Phl
n93679e4c35.summary: The Philippine Senate has passed a bill to develop the natural gas industry. It aims to boost local gas exploration and LNG infrastructure to ensure energy security and affordable prices.
n93679e4c35.why: Natural gas and LNG supply shape electricity prices and energy security for importers such as the Philippines.

n171f43f4ad.headline: Share market recovers after early bumps, Asian Paints stock tanks 9 pc
n171f43f4ad.summary: Indian shares recovered after initial losses on Monday, with selling seen in PSU banks and financial services. Asian Paints stock tanked 9 per cent.
n171f43f4ad.why: The Indian benchmark indexes track large listed companies on the National Stock Exchange and BSE, and Asian Paints is a major paint maker in the Indian market.

impacts.name: Asian Paints
impacts.why: Shares fell 9 per cent on the session.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n95c03bb87c.headline: Economist mocks FG, says Port Harcourt refinery totally obsolete
n95c03bb87c.summary: An energy expert says the Port Harcourt refinery and others in Kaduna, Eleme and Warri will not be operational anytime soon. The claim is an expert's view, not an official update.
n95c03bb87c.why: Nigeria's state-owned refineries have long been central to its fuel supply, and their operating status affects imports and the naira's fuel-import bill.
